name: hms-platform
description: Integrated hotel management, POS, inventory, purchasing, and finance platform.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hms/shared && npm run build -w @hms/api && npm run build -w @hms/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @hms/shared && npm run build -w @hms/api
scripts.build:netlify: npm run build -w @hms/shared && npm run build -w @hms/web
scripts.start:api: npm run db:deploy -w @hms/api && npm run start -w @hms/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @hms/api && npm run lint -w @hms/web
